headline: Fixed right. Explained straight.
intro: Services, brakes, diagnostics and repairs on all makes. We tell you what's wrong, what it costs and what can wait, before we start.
hours: Mon to Fri 7:30 to 17:00, Sat 8:00 to 13:00
service_1_desc: Oil, filters, plugs and a full inspection, done to your vehicle's service schedule.
service_2_desc: Pads, discs, shocks and bushes. If it squeals, pulls or knocks, we'll find out why.
service_3_desc: Engine light on? We plug in, read the codes and explain the fix in plain language.
service_4_desc: Clutches, cooling, electrical and engine work, quoted before we lift a spanner.
step_1_desc: WhatsApp the make, model and what it's doing. A video of the noise is gold.
step_2_desc: We check it, then quote. Nothing extra gets done without your OK.
step_3_desc: Collect your car with an explanation of what we did and what to watch for.
about_text: A good mechanic tells you what your car needs and what it doesn't. That's how we work: honest diagnosis, fair quotes and repairs done properly the first time.
faq_1_q: Do you work on all makes?
faq_1_a: Most local and imported vehicles. Send the make and model and we'll confirm.
faq_2_q: Will a service affect my warranty?
faq_2_a: Ask us about your vehicle's warranty terms and we'll explain how we service to schedule.
faq_3_q: How long will my car be in?
faq_3_a: Most services are same-day. Bigger repairs depend on parts, and we'll give you a realistic time upfront.
